Community Newspapers - Print and Digital | MakeMyNewspaper

### Once a Month Neighborhood Community Newspapers are Growing, Needed, Easy to Start, and Loved by Both Residents and Businesses

Simply put, to this day, the Internet has not found a way to reach directly to small neighborhoods the way a local newspaper does delivered directly to a neighborhood’s mailbox, doorstep, or email. Also, the micro-community newspaper, or neighborhood newspaper, usually running from 500 to 2,500 newspapers, offering news about schools, churches, road construction, charity events, special and family events, local business happenings, even pet care articles, is especially invaluable for the communities that they serve. Businesses love reaching people in their neighborhood, and citizens love to know what’s going on without fighting to find local information. And, you can start one almost immediately. A neighborhood newspaper is one of the most satisfying entrepreneurial jobs you’ll ever own, one of the cheapest businesses to start, the information for your neighborhood is easy to get, and EDDM by the Post Office has made it cheap to distribute to every door in your neighborhood.
